rows.consumer_context: Displayed button in status zoom controls, Navigate options and canvas-bounds editor. Calls paintCanvas.fit: adjusts zoom/pan to include whole canvas plus outlying trim/floating-selection bounds with handle padding. No image resampling or document-dimension change. May return early if viewport too small. Not the separate Fit image to canvas selected-image placement operation.
rows.rationale: Exact nonfuzzy LibreOffice Fit To Window value transferred to a viewport-fitting button. It denotes window-fit scale, not resizing image content. The English source is shorter, so this is contextual reuse, not an identical English/Amharic pair.

rows.consumer_context: Accessible caption for fit status button; also EditIcon.FIT label used for contentDescription and tooltip. Same viewport-only fit operation as ui_fit, including outlying selected/trim bounds rather than excluding them. Exact text is accessibility wording but source inspection is not screen-reader acceptance.
rows.rationale: HOLD: drawing-area noun phrase is composed and may mean viewport/editor area rather than bitmap canvas. Whole-area show imperative does not independently establish the precise fit/view relation. No accepted canvas technical term or complete caption attestation recovered. Do not implement or silently promote a replacement.

rows.consumer_context: Navigate options button chooses drawingTool remembered by showToolOptions whenever tool is not ZOOM; default PENCIL. It returns to the preceding non-navigation tool and Draw panel, not Undo/Redo, replay a stroke, or automatically draw. selectTool applies pending content before switch. Non-ZOOM includes selection/fill/etc, so label is conventional return-to-drawing-workspace phrasing, not guarantee that every prior tool makes a mark.
rows.derivation: exact source reuse with contextual transfer
rows.rationale: Exact Android user-redraw phrase transferred from lock-pattern entry, not repaint. Contextual risk remains: AN Paint returns remembered non-navigation tool, possibly selection/fill. Independent reviewer must assess whether this conventional return-to-drawing label is sufficiently broad; alternative return phrase in lexical report is unaccepted.

rows.consumer_context: View command toggles paintCanvas.grid; grid lines are drawn only when enabled and zoom>=8 (800%). Image-pixel rulers depend on grid toggle, not that same threshold. A display overlay, not grid baked into document pixels or image resolution change.
rows.rationale: Composed pixel+grid noun phrase from separate Android attestations, not an exact phrase match. Names an overlay rather than snapping, downsampling or changing image pixels.

rows.consumer_context: View command toggles fullscreen and calls syncFullscreen. Hides root controls except workspace, sidebar/status rails; adds Show controls return button and requests Android fullscreen status-bar flag. Does not claim navigation-bar immersive mode, image resizing, saving, or permanently hiding controls.
rows.rationale: Exact Android Full screen wording reused as a mode label, not resizing content. Source hides editor controls/status bar but does not guarantee immersive navigation-bar hiding.

rows.consumer_context: Full-screen workspace return button sets fullscreen=false then syncFullscreen restores editor root controls/rails and system UI flag subject to panel state. It does not open device-control settings or change canvas image content.
rows.rationale: Derived shortening of Android Show device controls, removing device qualifier, with independently attested Controls noun. Refers to restoring app controls by leaving fullscreen, not device-control settings.

rows.consumer_context: PaintTool.ZOOM label shown as View tool tile. chooseTool selects View and paintCanvas.selectTool first applies pending trim/polygon/curve/floating content. Subsequent ordinary single-finger drag pans and single tap neither draws nor zooms; pinch is separate zoom behavior. Navigation here is canvas inspection, not route guidance or file browsing.
rows.rationale: Composed view-movement tool noun from attested pan/movement root and view noun. Explicit view object distinguishes pan from moving drawing content; not exact Navigate phrase attestation. General Navigate alternative in LibreOffice is not proof of pan-specific meaning.

source_gate: No English-source defect established in this bounded inspection. Draw again denotes return to prior drawing-workspace tool, not automatic stroke replay. Fit description is inclusive of whole canvas, not exclusive of outlying handles/content.
excluded: Existing Zoom in/out translations and all36 ready additions plus Crop HOLD excluded.
